CROP / EYE IDENTITY TEST CANDIDATE - 29 October 2026

This is a new diagnostic candidate, not the previously confirmed alpha build.
Extract into a NEW folder, close LMU, and use this folder's launcher.

Changed:
- Quad mode bypasses LMU's saved FOV crop when allocating/rendering eye images.
  Your saved crop setting is not changed. Pimax QuadView FOV settings still apply.
- The final view-size answer reaching LMU is normalized to the selected runtime
  focus size. Logs show both the lower XR boundary and native game boundary.
- Native eye handles identify the game buffers; creation order and matching
  dimensions alone no longer identify an eye. Overlays remain separate.
- Resource/view identities, dimensions/formats, viewport/scissor state, native
  offsets, XR image indices and projection rectangles are logged.

Known limits:
The crop issue is confirmed by the supplied log, renderer analysis and tester's
setting report. The exact external size override in log 1 remains unknown.
An upper API layer may still rewrite swapchain sizes or wrap handles; this build
reports those cases without guessing an eye identity or stretching a cropped UI.
UNORM/sRGB compatible formats remain accepted; no new gamma conversion was added.

Test sequence (keep a log from each launch):
1. Leave the previous LMU cropping setting enabled; start with the new launcher.
2. Check the menu in both eyes, then load a track and enter the cockpit.
3. Check head movement, both focus regions, outer image, and optional green box.
4. Return to the menu; check that it remains live.
5. Close LMU, change Pimax focus/outer settings, and relaunch. Repeat 2-4.
6. Isolate native outer optimization: close LMU; select the correct game folder
   and Save settings in this folder's launcher. From PowerShell 7 in this folder:

   ./test-no-native-outer.ps1

   This keeps quad rendering and runtime settings, but disables the small native
   outer target bank. It renders full-size outer scenes then resamples them.
7. If Pimax FSR/NIS or another XR upscaler/override is enabled, repeat once with
   that setting off, changing only that setting and restarting the game.

Share the new quad log and whether menu/track/return worked, after reviewing logs
for personal paths. Success requires quadProjections=1 with captures=1/1, plus
correct visible focus and outer content. A nonzero counter alone cannot prove
visual correctness. These live tests must be done on the affected PC; local
automated tests do not reproduce its full runtime/layer setup.
